Looking at the table:  

- 厘 (lei4) has metric value "37.79931 mg" → not g.  
- 分 (fan1) has metric value "377.9936375 mg" → not g.  
- 錢 (cin4) has metric value "3.779936375 g" → yes, g.  
- 兩 (loeng2) has metric value "37.79936375 g" → yes, g.  
- 斤 (gan1) has metric value "604.78982 g" → yes, g.  
- 担 / 擔 (daam3) has metric value "60.478982 kg" → not g (kg).  

So characters with metric values measured in g: 錢, 兩, 斤 → that’s 3 characters, not 2.  

The statement says: "錢 and 斤 are the only characters that have metric values measured in g" — but 兩 also has metric value in g, so they are not the only ones.  

Thus the statement is false.  

Final Answer: No
